title: Elopura Marathon 2026 Review: Sabah's Second City, Under Its Old Name
meta_description: Elopura Marathon 2026 review: November 22 in Sandakan, Sabah -- named after the city's former name, organised by a local orthopedic association.
dek: Set for 22 November 2026, this marathon carries the name Elopura -- Sandakan's former name -- and is organised by Persatuan Ortopedik Sandakan, the city's local orthopedic association.
verdict: The Elopura Marathon carries genuine local historical weight in its name: Elopura was Sandakan's name at various points in its history, and Sandakan itself is Sabah's second-largest city after Kota Kinabalu, with over 439,000 residents as of the 2020 census. The organiser -- Persatuan Ortopedik Sandakan, a local orthopedic association -- gives this race a genuine medical-community backing distinct from commercial or corporate sponsors. Three distances (10K/21.1K/42.195K) with clear MYR pricing (RM140 half, RM170 full) make this a well-defined, if still-emerging, East Malaysia option.

sections.heading: A Race Named for Sandakan's Old Identity
paragraphs: The Elopura Marathon offers three distances: 10K, 21.1K and the 42.195K full marathon, priced at RM140 for the half and RM170 for the full. [1] Sandakan was formerly known at various times as Elopura -- the marathon's name is a direct callback to that historical identity, giving the event genuine local cultural resonance rather than a generic brand name.

sections.heading: Sabah's Second City
paragraphs: Sandakan is the capital of Sandakan District and Sabah's second-largest city after Kota Kinabalu, with a 2020 census population of 439,050 -- larger than the surrounding Sandakan district's roughly 396,000 residents. [2] The broader Sandakan Division is the largest of Sabah's five administrative divisions, covering 38.3% of the state's territory.

sections.heading: Organised by a Medical Association
paragraphs: The race is organised by Persatuan Ortopedik Sandakan -- a local orthopedic medical association -- giving it a genuine health-community backing distinct from the commercial and corporate sponsors dominating most races in this research batch. [1] That's a similar spirit to the Surabaya Orthopedic Half Marathon covered elsewhere in this research, though under a different organisational model (a medical association rather than a race branded simply after a medical theme).

sections.heading: Registration Not Yet Announced
paragraphs: As of this writing, registration status has not been announced. [1] The race is listed on international aggregators including AIMS World Running and Ahotu, alongside its own official site.

sections.heading: Should You Run It?
paragraphs: If you want a marathon with genuine historical and community roots in one of Sabah's major cities, the Elopura Marathon on 22 November 2026 is a solid, well-defined pick with clear pricing already set. Watch official channels for registration to open.
